_MACRO_TALK_KEYWAIT('dialogue_r216r0101', '00_msg_ev_r216r0101_icebeam_strong', 'Oh, hey, you’re a Trainer?
That’s awesome!Woah, you’re strong, too!
You have so many badges!I’ve been trying to hone a powerful
Ice-type technique, but I can’t do it.I think it would be best used by a
Trainer stronger than me.Like you, in fact!
I’ll pass this technique on to you.It’s the Technicial Machine containing
the Ice-type move: Ice Beam!'
